subject: NWEA MAP District Assessment Results
overview: The School Committee celebrated the award-winning Mustang Marching Band and received progress reports from the Missituk and Andrews schools. Much of the meeting was devoted to a detailed presentation and critique of the NWEA MAP district-wide assessment data and its role in informing classroom instruction.

items.title: Superintendent’s Updates and Student Recognitions
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent shared updates on the McGlynn Playground construction and literacy screenings before honoring the Mustang Marching Band and Color Guard for their first-place NESBA finals finish.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, and meeting minutes from November 20, 2023.

items.title: Missituk Elementary and Andrews Middle School Updates
items.summary: Principals Kathleen Kaye and Jennifer Skane presented highlights on student achievements, enrichment programs, and new academic initiatives such as ST Math at their respective schools.

items.title: NWEA MAP Assessment Presentation
items.summary: District staff presented fall assessment data showing Medford students generally outperforming national norms, though committee members requested more disaggregated data and clearer links to instructional interventions in future reports.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee observed a moment of silence for several deceased former staff members and community giants before adjourning.
